_note: Prompts for AI-generated mood images (scripts/generate-images.mjs). Each product's subject comes only from the odour notes in its own description in products.json. These are illustrative mood images, not photographs of Petorose products or facilities; never generate the plant, lab or people.
style: Premium editorial still-life photograph for a fine fragrance and flavour house. Soft directional window light, deep aubergine-to-lavender gradient backdrop, subtle violet rim light, shallow depth of field, rich but natural colour, crisp detail, generous negative space, minimal composition. Photorealistic. No text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, no people, no hands.
